tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Slide background. Black for cover and scope slides, paper for plan slides.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, key numbers and lead sentences on ground.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body text and bullet lists on ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Owners, footers and source lines on ground. 24px minimum.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: 1px rule above a primary column, such as a workstream.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px rule above secondary columns, number rows and footers.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: The one solid inverted block per slide, for the outcome or takeaway. Text on it uses ground.

tokens.name: space-rule
tokens.usage: Gap between a rule and the column title under it.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Gap between title, number row and columns.

tokens.name: margin-top
tokens.usage: Top margin; bottom is 160px when a footer is pinned at 64px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. No rounded cards, pills or photos.
